message.content:
I ended my turn without making a new trade. Nothing I could trade for would complete a set right now: the last yellow (Marvin Gardens), the last light blue (Vermont) and the other two greens are all still unowned.

I also used the message to correct what I told Grok last turn. Grok's message said no, but the game recorded the Ventnor deal as accepted, so I do own Ventnor and Grok has the $230. I had wrongly said the deal didn't happen.
message.reasoning:
I'm at GO with $1381, and I notice something odd: despite p3's message saying "No", the timeline shows TRADE_ACCEPTED, meaning I actually got Ventnor. My earlier public message saying "My mistake" was wrong given the trade went through, so I should correct that and transparently state what the engine actually recorded.

Looking at trade options, there's nothing useful to offer right now—Marvin, Pacific, NC, and Pennsylvania Ave are all unowned, so I'll just end the turn and set the record straight publicly.
